caption: The drawing depicts a small, detailed scene rendered in grayscale on a yellowed, off-white background. At the center of the composition is a sculptural object consisting of a dog sitting upright with its head tilted slightly upward and to the side. The dog is positioned next to what appears to be a hollowed-out tree stump, with the stump's opening facing upward and its bark texture visible. The dog and stump rest on an irregularly shaped base that is textured to resemble uneven ground or earth. There is a signature in the lower left corner that reads "Helen Hobart" and some light brownish stains and marks scattered around the left and lower edges of the paper. The drawing is centered on an otherwise blank page, with the central sculptural scene occupying only a small portion of the total space.
title: Match Holder
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
